sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — Mum's note
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Hi Tom,

I'm working late tonight, so can you go to the supermarket after school? We're having a party for Grandma on Saturday, and we need fresh ingredients.

We have enough rice, but we're running out of eggs, so please get six. We don't have any milk, so get two cartons. We also need a little butter and some cheese. They're in the dairy aisle, at the back of the supermarket. The fresh produce is at the front: please get a few tomatoes and a bag of apples.

Don't buy any cola, because Grandma doesn't like it. Get a bottle of orange juice instead. If the apples are out of stock, get some oranges.

The portions at Grandma's parties are always large, so please check: is there anything else we need?

Thanks!
Mum

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — At the supermarket
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Where is the rice?
The rice is next to the ___.
The customer needs ____ tomatoes.
Why are there only a few tomatoes?
What is out of stock?
A large packet of rice is ____ pounds.
Three bottles of water are…
The customer needs ____ bottles of water.

script: Excuse me. Which aisle is the rice in?
It's in aisle three, next to the bread.
Thanks. And do you have any fresh tomatoes?
Yes, they're in aisle one with the fresh produce. But we're running out, so there are only a few.
That's fine. I need four. Is there any yoghurt?
Sorry, the yoghurt is out of stock today. How about some cheese instead? It's in the dairy aisle.
OK, a little cheese, then. How much is a packet of rice?
A small packet is two pounds, and a large packet is five pounds.
A large packet, please. We have a big family.
Yes. Do you have any bottles of water?
Yes, in aisle four. Three bottles are two pounds today.
Great. I need six bottles, then. That's all, thanks!

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Call home from the supermarket

sentences.text: I'm at the supermarket now. Do we have any eggs at home?
We need a few tomatoes and a little butter.
We're running out of milk, so I'm getting two cartons.
The apples are out of stock, but there are some fresh oranges.
The rice is in the third aisle.
